active_family: 631 state-conditioned encoded-increment native joint flow with scale features
current_bottleneck: The active native joint model now learns good average increment law, mean reversion, co-movement, and conditionality, but conditional dispersion is still almost regime-invariant. Turbulent/calm width ratio is only 1.008 and a few IV tail cells remain too large, so the next issue is heteroscedastic scale control rather than data framing or paradigm.
last_result_summary: 631a added generic volatility-state prefix features to the 629a state-conditioned increment model. IV score improved to 4/11, passing conditionality, block-AR, cointegration, and cross-cell. Compared with 629a, conditionality MAE reduction improved to 8.9%, level KS pass improved to 8/25, median-bias pass improved to 16/25, and turbulent/calm width ratio improved from 0.894 to 1.008. It still fails surface explosion at 51.7%, coverage at 78.1% overall with per-cell failures, time-series tail scale, regime coverage, full-horizon mean reversion, and pathwise q90/q99 tails. Joint-panel audit remains strong: q99 pass 13/13, factor-factor corr 0.865, IV-factor corr 0.889.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 632a as a generic conditional source-scale head in the same state-conditioned increment flow, initialized at unit scale and bounded conservatively. This is a standard heteroscedastic conditional-flow mechanism and directly targets weak turbulent widening/conditional scale without IV/factor-specific branches.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. On the 441-window broad frame, 510a, 596a, and 610a all score 5/11. 574a remains the best risk-manager joint stress product but is a composed deck, not a calibrated joint law. 629a is now the cleanest native joint learned law by mechanism and joint-panel audit, but its IV full-suite score is only 3/11 because calibration/regime/level-occupancy failures remain.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
